newsitem.title: USA: Air Transportation names new CEO, president.
newsitem.headline: Air Transportation names new CEO, president.

text.p: Air Transportation Holding Co Inc said Monday it elected Walter Clark chairman and chief executive officer, replacing his father David Clark Sr, who died April 18 after a brief illness.
Walter Clark, a Charlotte, N.C. businessman involved in real state development, is a member of Air Transportation's board.
Hugh Bingham was elected president and chief operating officer, two offices which also were held by David Clark.
Bingham has been a senior vice president and member of the company's board since 1983.
